title: Ep 39 — The Big Three Talk Safety While Racing to List, and the Calorie App Built Over One Bank Holiday Weekend
description: OpenAI confirms it's coordinating AI safety policy with Anthropic and Google DeepMind, Anthropic's Nasdaq rumour firms up with real revenue numbers but still no on-record confirmation, and Google ships two new real-time voice models. Plus a deep dive on RevenueCat-verified calorie-tracking app nutrIA, built over a single Easter weekend, and updates for PlayFundWin, LeaguePages and EV-Partnerships including the Fundraising Regulator's site reopening after four blocked days and a twenty-second straight quiet episode for sports-venue EV charging.
